name: kaskas
description: Portable financial memory workflow for reviewing credit card statements, tracking obligations, detecting subscriptions, analyzing utilization, and optimizing cashback usage
author: rjramirez

interface.description: Review statements, track obligations, detect subscriptions, and optimize card usage

commands.name: review
commands.description: Analyze credit card statements, receipts, and transactions

commands.name: due
commands.description: Track credit card dues, subscriptions, and recurring bills

commands.name: subscriptions
commands.description: Detect recurring charges and subscription patterns

commands.name: offers
commands.description: Find best card offers and cashback opportunities

commands.name: safe
commands.description: Check safe spending limits and utilization risk

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export financial memory as JSON, CSV, or Markdown
